description:
Yoon Seoa, an ordinary city woman, finds herself stranded on a deserted island after a plane crash. In the middle of a vast ocean, where even the odds of survival seem slim, only one other survivor is waiting for her: Pyo Taejeong. With strikingly handsome features, an icy gaze, and overwhelming survival skills that remain unshaken even on a deserted island, Taejeong is unlike anyone Seoa has ever met. “Take everything off except your underwear.” Caught off guard by Taejeong’s blunt and relentless attitude, Seoa finds herself helplessly swept along by him... Will the two of them ever make it back home alive?
Source: MU
